title: Serum 2 Complete 127-Parameter Write Verification via AbletonMCP
summary: Complete verification that all 127 Serum 2 MCP-exposed parameters accept writes via AbletonMCP set_device_parameter. Every parameter accepted value 0.33 without error. Device On also verified writable and restored to 1.0 (On).

test_procedure.method: batch_commands() with set_device_parameter for all 127 parameter indices

device_on_handling.note: Device On (index 0, range 0-1 boolean) was included in batch 1. Write of 0.33 rounded to 0.0 = Off, disabling Serum.
device_on_handling.issue: Serum was muted/disabled after write test
device_on_handling.resolution: Restored Device On to 1.0 (On) immediately after session resume

state_restoration.action: Restored critical parameters to defaults for playable state

conclusion: All 127 MCP-exposed Serum 2 parameters accept write operations via AbletonMCP set_device_parameter. Zero failures across 127 parameters tested. Full programmatic control of all Serum 2 synthesis parameters is confirmed via Tier 2 (MCP) access.

architecture_implication.note: Completes Two-Tier Parameter Strategy verification: Tier 1 (16 Macros) for UI, Tier 2 (127 MCP) for full programmatic control — both tiers confirmed operational
